english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the infectious agent itself.
Use this when the illness bug means a virus or the viral cause of an illness.

examples.traditional: 呢種病毒好快就傳開喇。
examples.jyutping: ni1 zung2 beng6 duk6 hou2 faai3 zau6 cyun4 hoi1 laa3

examples.english: I think I’ve caught a bug, so I’m not going to work today.
examples.traditional: 我好似中咗病毒，今日唔返工喇。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 ci5 zung3 zo2 beng6 duk6 gam1 jat6 m4 faan1 gung1 laa3
